js: window.__until = async (f, ms) => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (;;) { try { if (f()) return true; } catch {} if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) return false; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } }; window.__advances = async (label, ms) => { const H = window.__hologram, T = window.__table; const v0 = H.textureVersion, t0 = H.status().currentTime, f0 = T.info().frame, w0 = Date.now(); /* software GL renders well under 1 fps on a loaded machine: measure over at least four rendered frames, not a fixed time */ while (T.info().frame - f0 < 4 && Date.now() - w0 < 60000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); if (Date.now() - w0 < ms) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms - (Date.now() - w0))); const s = H.status(); const frames = T.info().frame - f0; const r = { label, live: s.live, playing: s.playing, paused: s.paused, mapIsVideo: H.liveMix > 0.95, frames, textureUploads: H.textureVersion - v0, timeDelta: +(s.currentTime - t0).toFixed(2), error: s.error, tail: s.events.slice(-6) }; (window.__advLog ||= []).push(r); return r; }

name: prepared-at-idle
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.playing === false && (s.mode !== 'hls' || s.hls === true); }, 20000)

name: first-frames-advance
js: (async function(){ const r = await window.__advances('first', 2000); return r.mapIsVideo && r.frames >= 3 && r.textureUploads >= r.frames - 1 && r.timeDelta > 0.5 && r.paused === false; })()
